units.source_text: 我知道附近的名胜中有来历可疑的山椒大夫宅邸的遗址。

en.t: I knew that among the nearby sights there were the ruins of the mansion of Sansho the Bailiff, whose origins were somewhat dubious.

units.source_text: 我无意顺道去参观，不觉间就从宅邸门前走了过去，可能是只顾眺望河对岸的缘故吧。

en.t: I had no intention of making a detour to look at it, and before I knew it I had walked past the gate of the mansion, perhaps because I was absorbed in gazing at the far bank of the river.

units.source_text: 河中有一片被竹林包围的大沙洲。

en.t: In the river there was a large sandbar surrounded by bamboo groves.

units.source_text: 我沿路走来，没有风地，可是，沙洲那边的竹林子却随风摇曳。

en.t: Along the road where I had been walking there was no wind, yet the bamboo grove on the far side of the sandbar was swaying in the breeze.

units.source_text: 沙洲上有一块靠雨水耕作的水田，

en.t: On the sandbar there was a rice field cultivated with rainwater alone,

units.source_text: 面积约百余公亩，水里却看不见农夫的身影，

en.t: covering a little over one hundred ares, but no farmer could be seen in the water,

units.source_text: 只见一个人背向这边正在垂钓。

en.t: only a single person, with his back turned this way, was fishing.
